description: Query immutable ProofOfLogic certificates stored on Irys Datachain by DJZS Protocol. USE THIS TOOL when you need to verify audit history for an agent or project before delegating work, check FAIL verdicts, or retrieve certificates by Irys tx ID. DO NOT use for on-chain trust scores — use query_agent_trust for those.

from_ms.description: Start of the search window, as Unix time in milliseconds. When omitted the server searches the last 14 days, then the last 3 days if the wider search fails; set it to reach older certificates, and it is used as given

limit.description: Maximum number of certificates to return, newest first

targetSystem.description: Return only certificates whose Target-System tag equals this agent or project identifier (a project name or wallet address), matched exactly as written on the certificate

tier.description: Return only certificates carrying this tier tag

to_ms.description: End of the search window, as Unix time in milliseconds. When omitted it is one hour after the current time

verdict.description: Return only certificates with this audit outcome

name: query_pol_certificates

corrections.description: Correction Records anchored against this certificate

irys_id.description: Irys transaction id of the certificate

irys_url.description: Gateway URL to fetch the full certificate

timestamp.description: Index timestamp as returned by Irys

other_verdict_count.description: Certificates whose verdict is none of PASS, FAIL, WAIT

target_system_unverified_count.description: Certificates whose target_system carries the unverified: prefix

total_returned.description: Number of certificates in this response

from_ms.description: Window start actually searched, Unix ms

title: Query DJZS ProofOfLogic Certificates
